# Markasso

> Markasso is the whiteboard your AI agents draw on: an open source, browser-based whiteboard for diagrams (architecture, flowcharts, sketches) with an MCP server, so Claude, Codex, Gemini or any MCP client can create, read and edit real, editable diagrams, alone or live on a board shared with people. No account; boards are local `.markasso` files or share links.

Markasso runs at https://markasso.it (web app) and as a native Mac app. Diagrams are made of shapes, connected arrows, text and icons that stay editable by hand after an agent draws them.

## Connect an agent

The MCP server is the npm package `@markasso/mcp` (Node 22+, stdio). Examples:

- Claude Code: `claude mcp add markasso -- npx -y @markasso/mcp@latest`
- Codex: `codex mcp add markasso -- npx -y @markasso/mcp@latest`
- Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI, LM Studio and other clients: add `{"mcpServers": {"markasso": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@markasso/mcp@latest"]}}}` to the client's MCP config.

Also listed in the official MCP Registry as `io.github.AlbertoBarrago/markasso`. A Claude Code plugin adds the server plus a `diagram` skill.

## Docs

- [Markasso for AI agents](https://markasso.it/agents/): what agents can do, the demo, install commands
- [MCP server README](https://github.com/AlbertoBarrago/markasso/blob/main/mcp/README.md): every tool, live mode, layout warnings, security notes
- [User manual](https://github.com/AlbertoBarrago/markasso/blob/main/docs/MANUAL.md): the app, shortcuts, live sessions, import and export
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/AlbertoBarrago/markasso-plugin): MCP server and `diagram` skill

## How agents draw

- Document mode: `diagram_new` or `diagram_open`, `diagram_add_nodes` with short keys, `diagram_connect` by key, `diagram_layout` to arrange (no coordinates needed), `diagram_export_png` to look at the result, then `diagram_share` (markasso.it link), `diagram_save` (`.markasso`) or `diagram_export_svg`.
- Live mode: someone starts a live session in Markasso and shares its link; `live_join` puts the agent on the board, every change is applied for everyone, and `live_wait_request` / `live_reply` handle requests people send from the room.
- Node kinds: rectangle, ellipse, rhombus, text, icon (generic architecture and Kubernetes icons via `icons_search`) and flowchart symbols (terminator, data, document, database, predefined process, preparation, manual input, delay).

## Optional

- [Markasso Cloud](https://markasso.it/cloud/): paid add-on for cloud boards synced between web and Mac, and for inviting agents into live sessions
- [Markasso for Mac](https://markasso.it/mac/): the native app
- [Source code](https://github.com/AlbertoBarrago/markasso): MIT licensed
